source: Illinois Department of Public Health, Vital Statistics: Causes of Death by Resident County (annual PDF tables 2008-2023; original PDFs saved under sources/il_idph)
note: Top-10 statewide causes per year (the set changes by year: COVID-19 appears 2020-2022, septicemia and chronic liver in some years, suicide and liver 2008-2014 only), so each cause covers only the years it ranks. Counts of 0-9 are published exactly; no suppression rule stated on the tables. Column identity was read from each PDF header (order per year recorded in column_order). Chicago, Suburban Cook and other sub-county rows are ignored; Cook is the county total. Key accidents = unintentional injuries (not a MortalGIS measure).
log: duplicate rows resolved by larger total
known_issues: 2011 suicide column disagrees with CDC (e.g. Cook 336 vs CDC 365, DuPage 73 vs 91, Lake 55 vs 73); the other 2011 columns agree. build_data agreement gate would skip it.
Name aliased DeWitt -> De Witt to match CDC county names.
2011 suicide removed from this bundle; use il_injury_county_2010-2023.json for suicide (all years).
